title: Interplay of Depletion-Interaction and Viscosity Drives Non-Monotonic Ligand Binding to DNA G-Quadruplex under Crowding
authors: Ajay Kumar Chand; Pramod Kumar; Harsh Sahu; Shubham Kumar Sharma; Sobhan Sen
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟和动力学理论研究了拥挤环境下配体与G4 DNA的结合机制，虽非TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关的分子识别与物理模拟方法，可迁移至TF-DNA结合研究。
abstract: The study of ligand binding to G-quadruplex (G4) DNA under molecular crowding is essential for understanding its implications in cellular context; however, the underlying mechanism remains largely unresolved. Here we investigate the binding of TMPyP4 to parallel c-MYC G4 DNA under EG/PEG crowding using steady-state and fluorescence correlation spectroscopy (FCS). Ligand binding affinity (K) to G4 exhibits a pronounced non-monotonic, U-shaped dependence on crowder size – first decreasing due to viscosity-induced hindrance, then recovering for larger PEGs. Kinetic analysis of FCS data reveals that this arises from competing effects of crowder-induced viscosity and depletion interactions on ligand association (݇k on ) and dissociation (݇k off ) rates. A modified Collins-Kimball-Debye formalism, combined with hybrid MD simulations, shows that larger crowders create polymer-free depletion cavities that accelerate ligand/G4 association, counteracting viscous drag. These results provide a generalizable framework that connects polymer physics to nucleic acid-ligand recognition, useful for G4-targeted drug design in the crowded cellular milieu.
abstract_zh: 在分子拥挤条件下配体与G-四链体（G4）DNA结合的研究对于理解其在细胞环境中的意义至关重要；然而，其潜在机制在很大程度上仍未解决。在此，我们利用稳态和荧光相关光谱（FCS）技术，研究了在EG/PEG拥挤条件下TMPyP4与平行c-MYC G4 DNA的结合。配体对G4的结合亲和力（K）表现出显著的、随拥挤剂尺寸变化的非单调U形依赖关系——首先因粘度诱导的阻碍而降低，随后在较大PEG存在时恢复。FCS数据的动力学分析揭示，这一现象源于拥挤剂诱导的粘度与耗尽相互作用对配体结合（k_on）和解离（k_off）速率的竞争性影响。改进的Collins-Kimball-Debye形式体系结合混合分子动力学（MD）模拟表明，较大的拥挤剂会形成无聚合物的耗尽腔，加速配体/G4结合，从而抵消粘性阻力。这些结果提供了一个将聚合物物理学与核酸-配体识别联系起来的通用框架，对拥挤细胞环境中G4靶向药物设计具有实用价值。
